name: bridge
title: Bridge and culvert General Arrangement Drawings (railway and road)
family_procedure: Confirm the cues ON THE DRAWING before relying on this skill: zoom_view the views and read the printed words; a match from list_skills is a lead, not a classification.
If it applies: name parts with the vocabulary in `components`, look for the levels and relations in `representation`, and keep `failure` and the look-alikes in mind.
Every size, level and relation still comes from this drawing (inspect tools, find_values); use `check_rule` to compare a documented definition with the values you defined.
Say what you applied, assumed or found in conflict with record_finding; cite library ids as evidence.
If the cues contradict each other, or the drawing is a look-alike, do not force the skill: say so and ask_person.

family_sections.inputs: The sheet's views (pictures and inspect_sheet), its printed words (title, notes, labels, level texts), the sizes and levels it states. The `representation` section lists the facts a drawing of this kind normally states: compare, do not fill in.
family_sections.prerequisites: The cues in `recognition` are confirmed ON THE DRAWING (zoom_view; the printed words that matched are in list_skills). The look-alikes listed there are excluded, or both are said.
family_sections.dependencies: Recipes read-the-drawing, name-and-bind-sizes, relate-views-and-levels and handle-uncertainty; the records this skill cites (search_library / get_reference); the engine's own checks.
family_sections.outputs: set_structure in the model's own words; parts and values named from the drawing with evidence; the levels and relations the drawing shows; findings (record_finding) that cite this skill and the records used.
family_sections.validation: The engine validates every edit and the finish gate. For the definitions in `rules`, check_rule on the model's own values (advisory). A fact in `representation` the drawing does not state is reported as a gap, never filled.
